title: Coherent derived coefficient pullback comparisons and their canonical mates
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring B and the explicitly constructed common equivalence family E of [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding], let F_T be inverse image from the etale site followed termwise by E_T, including D+ into the full derived category. There are natural pullback isomorphisms D+(h_etale^*) followed by F_S to F_T followed by L(h_internal^*), for all scheme morphisms h:S to T. Their canonical right mates under the specified etale and internal derived adjunctions are invertible when h is qcqs. These pullback isomorphisms satisfy the displayed composition-square equation for every commutative square, using its equality of composite morphisms. This statement concerns individual functor comparisons and coherence; it does not assert the three-factor exchange comparison.

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemmas 5.4.1 and 5.4.3; Stacks Project Tag 09AK

proof.text: Obtain the coherent derived inverse-image family and its square equation, without any right-mate assertion.

Realization is fully faithful: use the existing fullness instance and injectivity of bijective_comparisonUpperStar_mapDerivedCategory_map on D+, then compose with the derived coefficient equivalence. The source Hom-bijection uses the previously recorded comparison injective-acyclicity theorem.

For each qcqs morphism, internal right derived direct image preserves the etale realization image. Apply the proved fully faithful mate criterion to the inverse of the chosen pullback isomorphism. This proves rightMate, and together with the supplied square assembles the original record.

proof_origin.note: E1 second reading: genuine decomposition into coherent pullbacks and preservation of etale origin, with a proved Yoneda mate criterion. One upper hole closed, two independent geometric holes added; no net hole reduction claimed.
